tools.name: screenshot_url
tools.description: Renders a public web page in a real browser and returns a screenshot: a preview image you can look at, plus a link to the stored file (kept about 4 hours). Supports device presets, full-page capture, a CSS selector, dark mode, and blocking ads and cookie banners. Fails for private or internal addres

tools.name: render_html
tools.description: Renders an HTML and CSS string (an Open Graph card, an invoice, a template) to an image or PDF in a real browser. Resources the HTML loads from the web are fetched. Each render counts against the account's plan.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Loads a public page in a real browser (scripts run) and returns its content as Markdown. The text is cut at max_chars; the result says where to continue (offset). Each call counts as one render against the account's plan.

tools.name: page_to_pdf
tools.description: Renders a public page to a PDF and returns a link to the file (kept about 4 hours; PDFs are not shown inline). Each render counts against the account's plan.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Returns the account's plan allowance: renders in total, available and used, the concurrency and per-minute limits, and when the period ends. Renders nothing and uses no credits.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Lists the device presets (phones, tablets, desktops) with their viewport size and pixel ratio, optionally filtered by a part of the name. Renders nothing and uses no credits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "screenshot_url" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
